articles.headline: Strack, Swords lead way as No. 11 Kentucky women roll to 74-28 win over Maine
articles.description: — Clara Strack scored 21 points, backup forward Savannah Swords scored 15, and No. 11 Kentucky overwhelmed Maine 74-28 on Friday at the Daytona Beach Classic.
